order: This pass records the second planning session's rulings into the plan document. It closes the three deferred audit items raised in that session: the first is superseded by a seat re-cast recorded elsewhere, and the second is adopted as a conscious trade-off, since dropping one model from rotation moves exhaustion handling to the human sooner. The third item is adopted as a concentration-risk watch, with a proposed rotation trigger attached to it, and exactly four seat re-castings then get applied throughout the plan document. The interactive coordinating seat gets recast as the session's own model, with a matched mirror alongside it, because its core function is direct user dialogue and the prior casting's prose was observed weakening. The deep-work seat loses its user-dialogue duty entirely and moves to goal-directed work alone, while the architecture seat's default, along with its ambiguous-goal and exhaustion fallbacks, gets set so one casting becomes preferred for bounded orders.
claims: The four seat re-castings were applied across the plan document, and the three deferred audit items were closed in the same pass. The work spans three files, the status file, the plan itself, and the probe runbook, adding 134 lines and removing seventy-six across that small set. The status file was updated to record the rulings and the completed lab-port work, and the handoff-drill line was relabeled to match the new casting choice. Each recast was then checked clause by clause against the guardrail it has to protect.
